description: Committed within-run l4-paired gate readings from real sota.yml artefacts. The l4-paired gate in packages/eval/src/bin/l4-pair.ts pairs the memory arm against the memory-free reference arm INSIDE ONE DISPATCH; it is the only reading the R45 revert rule consumes. A cross-run delta between two dispatches measures a treatment's contribution and is NOT this gate. `detectablePp` is the minimum detectable difference the pair reported, and is null where the run predates the field: the state those rows expect is invariant to it, which the R50 test asserts rather than assumes.
